commands.name: list show
commands.summary: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

commands.name: list add
commands.summary: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

args.name: name
args.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cartons.

commands.name: list check
commands.summary: Mark one item on the person's shopping list as bought (checked) or not bought. Take the id from get_shopping_list.

checked.description: true when the item is bought, false to put it back.

commands.name: recipes search
commands.summary: Search the person's recipes by title. Returns each match's id and title.

commands.name: recipes add-to-list
commands.summary: Add every ingredient of one recipe to the person's shopping list. Take the recipe's id from search_recipes.

list order.reason: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can.
list order.how: with Place order on the shopping list
